snippet.title: Kibu | Highlights Teaser
snippet.description:
A mini-trailer for my upcoming game, Kibu! Support me by wishlisting it: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2193150/Kibu/
Full trailer version: https://youtu.be/NzIQUu9hN-E?si=6PPovB1NuGWYqOoj

Kibu is an atmospheric adventure game about seeking wisdom in the heart of nature. Climb, glide, and fight your way through a series of stunning worlds, collecting treasures and encountering spirits on your journey to resurrect the ruined temple you call home.
Kibu is coming to PC via Steam later this year.

Created by solo indie developer, Jonas Manke AKA Studio Inkyfox (that's me!)
